mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of 1% or more signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with immediate market downturn.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of HOUST and UNRATE trends does not correlate with subsequent economic recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS and UNRATE trends does not correlate with subsequent late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or GDPC1 growth does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.
